text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 3, "unit": "cats", "kind": "count", "span": "He has 3 cats"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 3, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "He has 3 times as many dogs as cats"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 2, "unit": "rabbits", "kind": "count", "span": "He has 2 fewer rabbits than dogs"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 3, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "a fish tank with three times the number of fish as rabbits"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 1, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "gerbils that's 1/3 the number of fish (numerator)"}, {"id": "q6", "value": 3, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "gerbils that's 1/3 the number of fish (denominator)"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "dogs are 3 times the 3 cats"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s1", "q3"], "out": "s2", "note": "rabbits are 2 fewer than the dogs"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s2", "q4"], "out": "s3", "note": "fish are three times the rabbits"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s3", "q5"], "out": "s4", "note": "one part of the fish (the 1 of 1/3)"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s4", "q6"], "out": "s5", "note": "gerbils are that third of the fish"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "s1"], "out": "s6", "note": "cats plus dogs"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s6", "s2"], "out": "s7", "note": "add the rabbits"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s7", "s3"], "out": "s8", "note": "add the fish"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s8", "s5"], "out": "s9", "note": "add the gerbils"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "how many pets Larry has in all"}, "dismissed": []}
